new_findings_round2.title: K4 Bols wizard BLOCKED in test orchestration by 429 kiosk-login rate-limit
new_findings_round2.surface: Kiosk login endpoint POST /api/auth/kiosk-login during sequential automated test runs

captures: round-2/captures/wave-D/_network-K4-bols.log (3 × 429 POST /api/auth/kiosk-login, no kiosk-event/menu lines, no item-detail GET)
round-2/captures/wave-D/400-K4-00-step-base-viewport.png (visual: rate-limit screen 'Trop de requêtes — patientez 37s avant de réessayer' over 'Borne de commande' connexion-automatique idle)
evidence.root_cause: Wave Y rate-limit hardening (commit 2e2400724 'fix(wave-y rate-limit): env-knob admin-mutation + lift owner rapid CTAs + dynamic Retry-After toast') correctly throttles kiosk-login at ~3 attempts in short window. When tests run 4 wizards sequentially without inter-test cool-down or storage-state pre-auth, the 4th test hits the rate-limit ceiling.

proposed_fix.approach_1_test_side_only: Add 30s sleep between kiosk-login attempts in spec, OR pre-create a kiosk session via storageState in playwright.config.js fixture so each test reuses the same auth.
proposed_fix.approach_2_test_side: Split K1/K2/K3 into one file and K4 into a separate file with describe.serial + beforeAll waiting 60s; OR introduce a /e2e-only test-helper route to issue a fresh kiosk-token without going through rate-limited login.
proposed_fix.estimated_loc: 5-15 LOC test infra; ZERO production code change.
proposed_fix.scope: test/spec infrastructure only — NO product code change needed
proposed_fix.owner_note: The rate-limit behaviour itself is CORRECT and protective — visible UX is well-designed ('Trop de requêtes — patientez 37s avant de réessayer' with countdown). Only the TEST suite needs adapting.
